title: SQL Server: a pipeline over 300 tables is accepted at create

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, three schemas of 100 tables

symptom: Create accepted 300 objects, and the pipeline ran its snapshots. No error.
cause: The documented figure is advice: Databricks recommends 250 or fewer tables per pipeline.
effect: Nothing stops a pipeline over the recommendation at create.
